description: Defines the LendingStrategy enum for different loan types in the Fineract project, including their IDs, codes, and string representations.

classes.name: LendingStrategy
classes.description: Enumeration of different lending strategies with associated properties and utility methods.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Returns the LendingStrategy enum corresponding to the given integer ID.

methods.name: getMinValue
methods.description: Returns the minimum ID value among the strategies.

methods.name: getMaxValue
methods.description: Returns the maximum ID value among the strategies.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the name of the enum constant.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID associated with the strategy.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code string associated with the strategy.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the value string associated with the strategy.
